about: Lens profiles chosen by hand for cameras Gyroflow's database has none for, by lens type (lens_pick.rs). A camera's key is its brand and model as Gyroflow reads them (gyroflow-probe --lens: camera). recorded: the lens mode the camera writes (DJI: StreamMeta.fov_type) -> the type it is. types: in the order the Library offers them; profile: a key of Gyroflow's database (its file path under camera_presets), or null when the camera's own lens in the file is what it takes. A clip's own choice is source.lens_type in its .afp.json

types.label: Wide
types.note: Recorded as fov_type 1. With EIS off the camera writes its own lens and motion data in the file; with EIS on nothing yet

types.label: Normal
types.note: Recorded as fov_type 2. The original Osmo Action's standard lens (145°, f/2.8, by Silver): Anton's projects of the 2026-10-20 dive (0122-0135, EIS off, no motion data) use it and it works
